title: Teaching Albert Nicholas and Harold's boyhood
summary: Her father taught Albert Nicholas reading twice a week after the Navy; Harold recalls living near St. Philip as a boy and his own early job.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
